messages:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — SDK v26 staged cutover tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Need owners for canary buckets, smoke, and rollback readiness. Who can take which window? :wave:

Maria G: I can own west-canary (us-west1) smoke checks 09:00–10:30. Will run the smoke script and watch errors + latency.

Jordan: I’ll take east-canary (us-east1) and client telemetry sanity. I’ll watch error budget and traces.

Samir: I’ll be primary for rollback/cutover ops. Have rollback commands ready and a quick runbook. Slack me when we start.

Alex K: Thanks — can everyone confirm client-compat checklist is green and a comms draft exists? @Ravi P?

Ravi P: Comms draft is in #marketing-drafts — short note + migration guide. We’ll send to affected integrations (>=30k calls) 2 hours after success; immediate comms if we roll back.

Lee: Compat note: server-side shim accepts both old/new enum names, so most clients should be fine. We left v25 fallback in place for 24h.

Jordan: Telemetry flag path to watch: /telemetry/enable — I’ll toggle and monitor.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: sdk-v26-canary-west at 2026-06-10T09:00:00-07:00 (job id: job-8723).

Samir: Rollback steps (criteria: >1% 5m errors OR sustained 95th latency regression):

```
# rollback to v25
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/sdk-api sdk-api=redwood/sdk-api:v25.4.2
# wait for pods
kubectl get pods -l app=sdk-api -w
# revert traffic split
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/traffic -d '{"route":"sdk","split":{"v25":100}}'
```

Maria G: Smoke checklist I’ll run at start:
- run perf smoke `./scripts/smoke.sh --region us-west1`
- post sample payloads to /generate and /chat
- verify no >20ms median regression and no increase in error traces
I’ll post results (and a ✅) in this thread.

Alex K: Final asks before cutover: add phone numbers to the ops doc, @Samir please confirm rollback perms for Lee by EOD, and pin the checklist. I’ll be on the 09:00 bridge.

Lee: Perms assigned to me (confirmed). Added a quick note about deprec header handling in the runbook.

Jordan: I’ll join the 08:45 preflight Zoom for a 15m run-through — calendar invite sent.

Alex K: Perfect — thanks everyone. If anything changes, update the ops doc and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
